character: A brisk woman who looks about forty, compact and upright, thick dark brown curls pinned up tight with two wooden pins, a few threads of grey at the temples. Small round spectacles. A warm, knowing half-smile, eyes sharp and level. Ink stains on the fingers of her right hand
wardrobe: a dark green wool dress with the sleeves pushed to the elbow under a fitted charcoal waistcoat, a leather coin satchel worn across the body on a strap, a thick ledger bound in cracked brown leather, a pencil tucked behind one ear

full.framing: Full body standing portrait, front view, the ledger held open against her hip, plain neutral background.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, looking at the viewer over her spectacles, faint smile.

scene.framing: Perched on a tall stool beside the door of a crowded fighting pit under a bridge, ledger open on her knee, taking coins from an outstretched hand, raw timber beams and iron bolts overhead, oil lamps on chains, a sand ring and a shouting crowd blurred behind her.
